component_units.freeform_ref_ll: mean teacher-forced reference-answer logprob per reference token on eval_freeform/dev.jsonl
component_units.mcq_gold_ll: mean full-vocabulary gold answer-letter logprob per MCQ item on data/val_v3.jsonl

rationale: Equal weighting is a frozen neutral starting prior for Phase 4: MCQ gold-token LL and free-form reference LL each get one vote, with no tuning against dev results. #35 must sanity-check ranking and variance before this objective is used by the accept/revert gate.
